items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: I never got to know him.

ctx.x: Well I'll tell you I used to be tickled to death to hear Georgia Barrett. Oh yeah. I mean Georgia Barrett yeah. He was my favorite. Yeah. I never got to know him. You never got to know him? No? No. No he died years ago. Kid Howard was playing with him or he was playing with Kid Howard.

No Lee Collins used to talk to me about him. He'd leave once. Lee Collins had me to go down. I met his widow. You met his widow? I saw a picture of him. She was living up on Perdido Street. All that's torn down. I don't know where she is now.
No Miss Rose or Daisy I think the name is.
